description: This file defines the UpdateCollateralProductCommandHandler class, which handles update commands for collateral products within the collateral management module of the Fineract project. It uses Spring annotations and interfaces with a service to perform update operations based on received commands.

classes.name: UpdateCollateralProductCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles update commands for collateral products, implementing command processing logic by delegating to a write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the update command by invoking the updateCollateral method on the write platform service.
